def hasWitness (p B n : Nat) : Bool :=
  let lo := n + 1
  let hi := n + B - 1
  (List.range (hi - lo + 1)).any (fun i =>
    (List.range (hi - lo + 1)).any (fun j =>
      (lo + i) * (lo + j) % p == 1 % p))

def B : Nat := 32
def P : Nat := 101
def coreExc : List Nat := [7, 13]

def check_core : Bool :=
  (List.range 61).all (fun n =>
    coreExc.contains n || hasWitness P B n)
